company.introduction: SSE owns and develops electricity infrastructure, combining regulated networks with renewable and flexible power generation. Its activities include transmission and distribution assets, wind farms, hydroelectric facilities and other generation or storage capacity. Revenue comes through network arrangements and the production or supply of electricity, with different businesses exposed to different pricing mechanisms. Building new infrastructure requires substantial capital and long project schedules. The company is connected to the expansion of electricity demand and the changing generation mix, but financial outcomes depend on execution, financing and regulatory conditions. Weather, power prices and the availability of generating assets also affect performance.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
